villageLost.beat: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

deaths.who: a red moon rising between the trees, breathing

deathDayLines.line: — DAY 17 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Stinging Nettle went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👀 Someone asks Jorge a shop-talk question about HVAC tech work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
🔥 “I don’t say this lightly.” Nganga sets their bowl down. “Chloe, your past story isn’t true, is it? I’ve heard enough versions now.” Nobody looks at Chloe. Everybody does.
Rowan Goldstein reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
"You haven't earned that yet," Willie says. (Trust too low.)
🌱 Charlotte waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Charlotte checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~30 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the water run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
💧 Charlotte returns with 17L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
Rowan heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
🩹 Nganga is hurting (41 HP) — Chantal patches them up before they head out. (41 → 66 HP)
👥 Nganga heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
👥 Charlotte walks out with Nganga. "Nobody walks alone today."
🚶 Dale is back — found Mariana.
Jorge heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
Chantal heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."

Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.

You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Willie looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)

💧 Ava returns with water: +4 clean.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Willie shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Rowan telling Jorge about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
You catch fragments by the fire — Willie telling Jorge about Rowan. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
🚶 Charlotte is back with Nganga.
💧 Rowan returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 Nganga returns with water: +4 clean.
🚶 Mariana is back — found Dale.
🪤 Jorge is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
🪤 Jorge is back from the pit line. "Pit was quiet. They'll keep."
Ava heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
💧 Zoltan returns with water: +2 clean.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
🌀 Green Thumb, Literally is STRAINING at its edges. The gift wants to become something — and it wants YOU to choose what.
"IT’S MOLTING! We didn’t program molting! This is YOUR doing! CHOOSE! Choose what it becomes!"
(Evolution awaits — choose one. Your power becomes something new.)
"Oh! OH! You're starting to GET it! The audience loves the little ah-ha moments! The odds just shifted!"
💛 You hold Carpenter's square and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Green Thumb, Literally)
Travel 1 tile to grove.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hummice is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
You catch fragments by the fire — Chantal telling Charlotte about Dale. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Lockpick is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Wound the lead — Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chantal is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
◈ CRISIS — THE FIRST GRAVE. Chantal is dead. The village digs its first grave, and everyone understands at once: this place can kill you. It just did.
SYSTEM: "Oh. Oh no. Was that supposed to happen? The audience is crying. I did not know they could do that."
📖 The entry for Chantal is finished. No more pages.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to meadow.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 15× Blackberry, 6× Purslane (1155 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
The Hushpuppy stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
While you were gone — 5 things you missed:
⚔️ Dale killed the Hummice alone — 1 round, 6 taken. Word travels fast. Took Wrong bandage off the body. The village cheers.
🩸 The Hushpuppy mauled Chantal (-52 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.
⚔️ Willie killed the Lockpick alone — 2 rounds, 25 taken. Word travels fast. Took Can labeled BEANS off the body. The village cheers.
🩸 The Hushpuppy mauled Chantal (-58 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.
💀 The Hushpuppy killed Chantal in 1 round. The village mourns.
You keep a day's food (1155 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
You walk back into Haven. 18 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
You coax 4 growing beds forward by 12 days. The next harvest carries the growth magic.
(−200 kcal — food becomes green thumb.)
Harvest: 60× Purslane, 60× Purslane, 60× Purslane, 60× Purslane. About 7200 kcal before preparation.
You chew the bitter leaves. Folk say it helps — you wouldn't know. (+2 health, maybe)

Deeper knowledge: Blackberry. Uses: vitamin C, antioxidants. Leaves for diarrhea. High energy. (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: ripe black berries, straight off the cane; medicine: leaf tea settles the stomach; dye: deep purple-black dye from the juice.
You eat Blackberry and Purslane (1425 kcal).
📋 Willie — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
📋 Charlotte — 🍲 Cook. Charlotte nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.

Rowan leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Lockpick. Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase."

You catch fragments by the fire — Mariana telling Dale about Ava. The story's getting bigger than what happened.

💧 Dale returns with water: +4 clean.

SYSTEM: Deep integration. You see the world through us now.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 82. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 6."
The overlay's tone has changed around you. Warmer. It notices you noticing.
◈ THE GRANT — full integration. The System opens the last slot like a door it built just for Booker. "You have been adequate entertainment. We upgrade adequate." (Ability slots: 6)
◈ FULL INTEGRATION — you don't look AT the System anymore. You look WITH it.
✅ The System watched the whole lesson twice. "NOTED. Filing under: things that are food, which is still a confusing category." (+8 integration)
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 17 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
🗣️ Nganga to Chloe, by the fire: "Stone. We need 55 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +1010 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Mariana set out an extra bowl before catching themself. Nobody mentioned it.
Charlotte is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 84/100)
Dale and Charlotte lingered over the fire together.
Jorge and Nganga lingered over the fire together.
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.

The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)

(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")

"Booker's gone." Rowan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Booker." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Charlotte blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.

At the grave, Rowan speaks for Charlotte — "Booker trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Charlotte before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

The relief moment passes — the crisis runs its own course now. What you did stands; what you didn't, doesn't.
